regime_definition: 0.5*z(breadth1 vs prior 12 months)+0.5*z(breadth6 vs prior 12 months); threshold ±0.50; neutral in between

development_selected_conditional.selection_basis: highest DEV geometric monthly return in the full conditional pair grid shown by the SQL probe; OOS/HOLDOUT excluded from selection

best_oos_seen_in_same_grid_but_not_selec.warning: This is a post-selection OOS observation, not the DEV-selected formula; it must not be used as evidence of validated performance.

development_selected_blend_probe.selection_basis: highest DEV geometric monthly return among tested two-factor blend probes

best_oos_seen_in_unrestricted_blend_grid.warning: Observed while inspecting the grid; it was not selected from positive DEV performance and is therefore not a valid final result.

conclusion: No development-selected conditional pair or two-factor blend reached the 7% monthly OOS hurdle, and none of the tested probes provided independent holdout confirmation at the 7% hurdle.
note: The workflow is manual and requires the SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY GitHub secret. Holdout is reporting-only and excluded from selection. This monthly engine is not the exact daily M1 benchmark.
